deals.title: Want to see Vienna's best skyline completely for free
deals.description: Want to see Vienna's best skyline completely for free? Head over to Westbahnhof, where you don't even need to go inside the IKEA store! Just hop into the glass elevators located right outside the building and ride them straight up to the 7th-floor rooftop terrace. It is open to the public with no entry fee, stunning plants, and plenty of space to relax and watch the sunset. Save this video for your next hangout in Vienna and tag the friend you're taking with you! #freeviewsvienna #ikeaviennaroof
